_about: Morvane's spoken lines (hand-written; ElevenLabs only reads them). Source of truth for tools/install_voices.py, which writes scripts/lore/data/morvane_lines.js and installs the picked takes. fx: far = before the Rift (filtered, distant), mid = in the Hollow, dry = in the fight. The fight lines (act 'The fight') are voiced without the player's name; their chat text stays in lore/data/reveal.js and bestiary/morvane.js.

voice.description: A monstrous, demonic male voice: something that was once a man and has been hollowed out by centuries in the dark. Extremely deep, rasping, guttural bass with a growl under every word and a faint inhuman double tone, as if two throats speak at once. Slow, cold, deliberate and in total control, old-fashioned precise English. Breathy menace, never shouting; each word dragged up from deep in the chest.

lines.when: Your first dusk in the world, once.
lines.text: You do not remember packing it. That is all right. You will need it. Keep it close.
lines.why: Echoes the journal's first line. The last page: You did not pack this book. I did.

lines.when: The first time you finish the Old King's Journal.
lines.text: His last line was for his son. Listen before you ring. Listen to me.
lines.why: He twists Aldric's warning into: listen to him.

lines.when: Dusk of your first siege night.
lines.text: Third night. They are coming for your walls. Hold them, and I will tell you who sent them.

lines.when: The morning after your first siege is held.
lines.text: Well held. You are stronger than the others were. That is why I chose you.
lines.why: He chose you as his key.

lines.when: When the Ember falls near your keep.
lines.text: Pick it up. It fell for you. Keep it, and it will lead you to the rest.
lines.why: The Ember is a splinter of his Crown, sent to mark you.

lines.when: The first time you bring down the Warlord King.
lines.text: He will get up again. Strike at the ones who give him strength. There are five. I will show you the way.
lines.why: Vorlund's Ledger clue: I have never seen him. I know the voice.

lines.when: When the Clockwork Reeve falls.
lines.text: Seventeen minutes past three, kept for three hundred years. Take what it carried. Keep it safe.
lines.why: Every boss carries a Choir Shard. Five make the Tuning Fork that opens the Rift.

lines.when: When the Pale Huntsman falls.
lines.text: He walked off the ice alone, and now he will not walk at all. Take the shard. Keep it safe.
lines.why: Same: the shards are his key.

lines.when: When the Drowned Bride falls.
lines.text: Her letters will stop now. Take the shard. Can you feel it humming? Good.

lines.when: When the Ash Seneschal falls.
lines.text: He kept my keys a long time. Take the shard. Keep it safe for me.
lines.why: My keys: the Seneschal served him, and the shard is a key.

lines.when: When the Mother of Changelings falls.
lines.text: She would have killed you to keep her name. Take the shard. Keep it safe.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: Every third night they knock. I can make it stop. Open the door, and it stops.
lines.why: The lie that gets the Rift opened.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: Your bells are louder than ours were. It will not matter.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: Somebody up there is ringing too soon. Listen to me instead.
lines.why: Listen before you ring, turned to his use.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: I can hear your heart from here. It is louder than your walls.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: You sleep with your boots on now. Good. Keep them on.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: They will keep coming until the door is open. Then it ends. I promise.
lines.why: It does not end: the seep spreads forever while the Rift is open.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: My father heard this too. He never once answered. You will.
lines.why: Aldric's journal: singing under the floor every third night.

lines.act: Third nights (each once, now and then)
lines.when: Faint, inside the singing on a third night.
lines.text: The ones I... the ones who hunt you are only the first. Find the five.
lines.why: A slip: the ones I sent.

lines.when: When you strike the Tuning Fork and the Rift opens.
lines.text: There. Thank you. I could not reach you through a closed door, so I sent them up, and you carried every shard to it for me.
lines.why: The mask drops: the bosses were his, and the shards were his key.

lines.when: Your first steps in the Hollow.
lines.text: Come down. Mind the light. I have waited such a long time to meet you.

lines.when: When the Choir is silenced.
lines.text: You silenced my Choir. Good. Now there is nothing left between us. Come up.
lines.why: Stage 6: There is only the one chair.

lines.when: He rises from the Seat. The first time you see who has been talking.
lines.text: Sit, then. If you can take it from me.

lines.when: Stage 4, under your own sky gone the wrong colour.
lines.text: This was mine first. And thanks to you, it is mine again.

lines.when: Stage 4 breaks and the ground takes you back down.
lines.text: Not here. Not under this sky.

lines.when: Stage 6, the Fall: alone with him.
lines.text: Sit, if you like. There is only the one chair, and I have had it three hundred years.

lines.when: Stage 6.
lines.text: I was a king. Yours. They threw me down here, and I have been pulling at your world ever since.

lines.when: Stage 6.
lines.text: The Reeve, the Huntsman, the Bride, the Seneschal, the Mother. Mine, every one. I sent them up to kill you.

lines.when: Stage 6.
lines.text: And when you kept winning, I let you. Every shard you took from them was a piece of my key.

lines.when: Stage 6.
lines.text: I could not reach you through a closed door. So I made you open it. You did it so well.

lines.when: Stage 6 breaks.
lines.text: Good. You did not come down here to talk either.

lines.when: The reveal: the boy at the desk ages into him and looks up. The only spoken line in the scene.
lines.text: You kept my father's book.

lines.when: New: as he falls for good.
lines.text: You opened the door. It does not close.
lines.why: New: the seep keeps spreading while the Rift is open.
